name: kargo
title: Kargo
description: Last-mile logistics simulation: bid nightly in a sealed-bid reverse auction for a growing shipper's delivery lots, then dispatch a fleet of trucks across a congested city over 60 days. 2 or 4 players.

days.description: Business days in the episode. Each day is 3 overnight steps plus 5 driving blocks. Informational: the engine runs a fixed 60 days.

blockMinutes.description: Simulated minutes per driving decision block.

shiftMinutes.description: Straight-time minutes before overtime begins. Past this, wages are 1.5x and driver stats decay 2x.

deadlineMinutes.description: Minutes after 08:00 at which the standard service deadline falls. Deliveries after it take the late penalty.

gridSize.description: Arterial grid dimension. The travel network is gridSize x gridSize intersections at ~1.5 km spacing.

warehouses.description: Communal shipper-owned warehouses, placed per episode. Every lot originates at one of them.

truckPcu.description: Passenger-car equivalent of a player truck: how much player trucks congest each other. One of low, medium, high.

startingTrucks.description: Owned trucks each player starts with, taken in order from VAN, VAN, STEP, each with a mid-tier driver.

seed.description: Optional input seed for deterministic episode generation. The interpreter clears this from configuration after reading and stores the resolved seed on env.info['seed'] so it stays out of agent observations but is still recorded in the replay.

reward.description: Net worth at the end of the episode: cash + fleet book value - outstanding debt.

city.description: Static road graph, known from day 0: grid size, edge list with road classes, per-node district labels, and warehouse node ids. Never changes during an episode.

traffic.description: Live shared conditions: per-edge ordinal congestion level (one of FREE, LIGHT, MODERATE, HEAVY, SEVERE, GRIDLOCK), active incidents and closures, current weather, and tomorrow's noisy forecast. Never the raw v/c.

market.description: Tonight's public market: spot lot listings (with retry counts), standing account listings, used-truck listings, rental pool, labor pool candidates (id, name, resume rating, asking wage), fill ceiling and service interval.

public.description: Per-player public state, indexed by player: cash, net worth, fleet roster (type, age, odometer, status), driver roster (name, tenure, resume rating -- never wages), held standing accounts, and lagged end-of-day lot results.

history.description: Published record: last night's awards and bid book, the latest fleet and labor logs, and live standing accounts.

private.description: This player's private state only: truck positions, loads, fuel, km_since_service, driver wages, today's manifest with windows and noisy service estimates, lots, pending lots, events and sightings of rival trucks.

phase.description: What this step accepts: DRIVING, CAPEX, LABOR, or CONTRACTS.

day.description: Current day index, 0-based. Day 0 is a Monday.

block.description: Driving block within the day, 0-4. Meaningless outside a DRIVING phase.

minute.description: Simulated minutes since 08:00 at the start of this block.

action.description: Phase-dependent object. DRIVING: {"trucks": {id: {load, route, on_missed_window, wait_cap, then, hold}}, "abandon": [lot, segment or door ids, block 0 only]}. CAPEX: {"fleet": [[op, arg]], "fuel": [[op, truck]], "stage": {truck: warehouse}}. LABOR: {"labor": [[op, ...args]]}. CONTRACTS: {"bids": [[lot, ask]], "standing_bids": [[account, rate, term]], "max_lots": number}.
